entities.name: Anicetus Bongsu Antonius Sinaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anicetus Bongsu Antonius Sinaga, was the Indonesian Roman Catholic bishop of the Diocese of Sibolga and then Archbishop of the Archdiocese of Medan from 2009 to 2018.
